question: Where is the nearest restaurant you encounter heading toward Hermosa Beach Historical Society Museum, Hermosa Beach, CA from the Last House on Mulholland, Los Angeles, CA?
sql: WITH start_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Last House on Mulholland%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Los Angeles%' LIMIT 1 ), end_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hermosa Beach Historical Society Museum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hermosa Beach%' LIMIT 1 ), path_segment AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS geom FROM start_poi s, end_poi e ), buffered_path AS ( -- Create a 500-meter buffer around the path segment to define "on the way" SELECT ST_Buffer(ps.geom::geography, 500)::geometry AS geom FROM path_segment ps ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, start_poi sp WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_path)::geography) ORDER BY ST_Distance(sp.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
